pages.text: With Curios installed, equip these in the Goggles slot to build without observing qBlocks.
pages.title: Anti-Obs. Goggles

pages.text: The equipped pair prevents your presence and placement from observing qBlocks. Other players and powered observers still can. Take the goggles off to observe again.
pages.title: Work Around a qBlock
Quantum Goggles
pages.text: This pair fits in the same Goggles slot for appearance. Find it in the qCraft creative tab. It has no special observation effect or survival recipe.
